repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 30-second sustained wait (30 SEC) before acting. The candidate uses a 1000 ms period and a threshold of 30, triggering at 29 seconds (29 ticks * 1000 ms + initial tick). The IR waits until the 30th second mark (30000 ms). The mismatch at 29000 ms confirms the candidate fires one period too early because the threshold should be 31 (30 seconds / 100 ms grid + 1) to align with the 30-second deadline.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the period from 1000 to 100 ms to match the fine-grained timing required for a 30-second wait. Updated the threshold from 30 to 31 so the action fires exactly at 3100 ms * 100 = 31000 ms? No, wait. 30 seconds = 30000 ms. With 100ms period, ticks are at 0, 100, 200... 30000 is tick 300. The rule is threshold = duration_ms / period_ms + 1. 30000 / 100 + 1 = 301. The candidate used 30. The fix is to set period=100 and threshold=301.
